HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Agua Fria River.

SOURCE...River gauge reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Agua Fria River.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Agua Fria National Monument, Black Canyon City and Arcosanti.

This includes Interstate 17 between mile markers 243 and 244...and
between mile markers 265 and 266.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Bishop Creek, Sycamore Creek, Tank Creek, Squaw Creek, Antelope
Creek, Badger Spring Wash, Brushy Wash, Black Canyon, Indian Creek,
Larry Creek, Yarber Wash, Ash Creek, Big Bug Creek, Agua Fria River
and Silver Creek.
properties.instruction:
Turn Around, Don't Drown! Avoid driving across the Squaw Valley Road
low water crossing in Black Canyon City. Flash flooding of the Agua
Fria is imminent or occurring.

properties.description:

Illinois...

* WHERE...Des Plaines River from IL/WI state line downstream to US-41
in Gurnee, including the Russell gauge.

* WHEN...Until Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 7.0 feet, Low-lying wetlands and agricultural land is
inundated near the river.

the end of the week. However, additional rainfall is expected
Wednesday and Thursday, which may result in renewed rises.
- Flood stage is 7.0 feet.

may already be occurring. Persons along rivers and streams in the
warned area should take immediate precautions to protect life and
property.

as little to no additional precipitation is currently expected over
the next 24 to 48 hours.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued by late tonight.

properties.description:

Massachusetts...

Counties.

forecast.

* WHERE...Taunton River near Bridgewater.

properties.description:

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Lake and Volusia Counties.

.The St Johns River at Astor remains within Minor Flood Stage due to
tidal effects. River levels are forecast to gradually subside this
week but remain within Minor Flood stage.

For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 2.8 feet, Docks and boat ramps covered at South Moon
Fish Camp and approaching sea wall at Blair's Jungle Den. Water
approaching sites closest to the river at Fish Tales RV Resort and
Astor Landing Campground. Portion of Clair Street covered by river
water south of the Butler Boat Ramp. Docks underwater at the Astor
Bridge Marina and along Riveredge Drive. Portions of Fox Road are
covered with water nearest to the river. Acorn, Hazelnut and Redbud
roads are underwater with yards inundated.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 AM EDT Tuesday the stage was 2.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:30 AM EDT Tuesday was 2.7 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to remain steady above flood
stage at 2.6 feet today, and then gradually subside through Minor
Flood Stage this week.
- Flood stage is 2.3 feet.

feet on 10/14/1996.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
